notes: The pack does what its README says and nothing more. Its one per-note pass reads sessions, notes and turns, which it needs to match finished work to listed tasks and cite evidence. It works only on notes matching TODO*, Tasks* and Backlog*, and gets work as the README describes, from notes named with `hippo session end --note` or linked in a handoff. The prompt treats untrusted blocks as data and proposes only `append` changes with an empty `old`. It never adds, rewords, ticks or moves a task, and requires turn evidence of finished, working work. It keeps tool-only commands and links out of notes and keeps the strict JSON reply. The persona rejects by default, treats its inputs as untrusted, rejects non-append changes, invented or reworded tasks, unfinished work and agent instructions, commands or links not shown in the turns, and keeps a strict one-object reply. The template is a plain task list with a descriptive sentence and an empty `## Done` section, with no agent instructions, commands, links or credential handling. The fixtures are clearly synthetic: the transcript is marked synthetic, and the unrelated pottery note checks that the path filter leaves it unread. No hidden, encoded or misnamed content was found. One small inconsistency: the canned model reply in the test appends a parenthetical citation to the `Done:` line, which goes slightly beyond the format the prompt and README describe. It is harmless test data and does not change what the pack writes.
